user.title: Connect Split-Flap OS
user.description: Enter the MQTT topic prefix used by the ESP32 master. The default firmware uses `splitflap`.

data_description.topic_prefix: Status is read from <prefix>/status and commands are sent to <prefix>/command/*.
data_description.name: Name shown in Home Assistant and on the sidebar panel.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Split-Flap OS is already configured. Only one display can be managed per Home Assistant instance.

error.invalid_prefix: Use a non-empty MQTT prefix without + or # wildcards.

init.title: Split-Flap OS options
init.description: Change the MQTT prefix or display name. The integration reloads after saving.

error.invalid_prefix: Use a non-empty MQTT prefix without + or # wildcards.

send_text.name: Send text
send_text.description: Send wrapped text to the split-flap display. Characters missing from a module's reported flap list are rejected.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text to display. New lines start a new row.

style.name: Send order
style.description: Animation order used when sending characters to the modules.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Delay in milliseconds per module. Sent with the display command; the current master firmware ignores it.

stop.name: Stop current app
stop.description: Stop any running app or playlist before showing the text.

raw.name: Raw board
raw.description: Use the text as complete board data; do not wrap it or change case.

play_playlist.name: Play playlist
play_playlist.description: Play a list of pages, optionally looping. All pages are checked against the modules' flap lists before playback.

pages.name: Pages
pages.description: JSON array of strings or page objects with text, delay, style and speed keys.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Seconds to wait after each page finishes moving.

app.name: App
app.description: App key, for example clock, weather, stocks, crypto, sports, metro, countdown, world_clock, iss or animations.

stop_app.name: Stop app
stop_app.description: Stop the active app or playlist.

sync.name: Sync state
sync.description: Ask the master to republish its current state.

scan.name: Scan bus
scan.description: Scan the RS485 bus for modules.

update.name: Update modules
update.description: Refresh known modules without a full scan.

calibrate.name: Calibrate module
calibrate.description: Send a calibration command to one module.

flap.name: Flap
flap.description: Character to move the module to when the action is goto and index is omitted.

home_offset.name: Home offset
home_offset.description: Steps from the hall sensor to the first flap (apply action).

positions.name: Position map
positions.description: Drum index to absolute position step mapping (apply action).

clear_map.name: Clear map
clear_map.description: Clear the stored position map in EEPROM before applying (apply action).

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: Relative steps; the integration converts them to an absolute position using the module's last reported step.

drum.name: Drum
drum.description: Exactly 64 characters, one per flap, without line breaks (drum_write action).

record_all.name: Record all
record_all.description: Record one drum index on every known module.

pages.name: Pages
pages.description: JSON array of strings or page objects.

run_saved_playlist.name: Run saved playlist
run_saved_playlist.description: Run a named playlist in a loop.

set_settings.name: Set settings
set_settings.description: Merge and persist Split-Flap OS settings.

settings.name: Settings
settings.description: Settings keys and values to merge.
